question.text: SBI Capital Markets was created in which year as a separate entity for merchant banking?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM-Series-IX Merchant Banking workbook (p.23), SBI Capital Markets was set up in 1986 as a separate entity for SBI's merchant banking activities. SBI had earlier set up its merchant banking division in 1972 (p.22). The Trap: 1972 is the year of SBI's internal merchant banking division, not the separate entity. 1980 and 1991 are not the dates cited in the workbook for SBI Capital Markets. Note: Page 23 also mentions ICICI Securities (1995) as a related corporatization; keep the answer tied to the pp.22-23 dates only.
